verse.verse_1: Qaf: By the Glorious Qur'an (Thou art Allah's Messenger).
verse.verse_2: But they wonder that there has come to them a Warner from among themselves. So the Unbelievers say: "This is a wonderful thing!
verse.verse_3: "What! When we die and become dust, (shall we live again?) That is a (sort of) return far (from our understanding)."
verse.verse_4: We already know how much of them the earth takes away: With Us is a record guarding (the full account).
verse.verse_5: But they deny the Truth when it comes to them: so they are in a confused state.
verse.verse_6: Do they not look at the sky above them?- How We have made it and adorned it, and there are no flaws in it?
verse.verse_7: And the earth- We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and produced therein every kind of beautiful growth (in pairs)-
verse.verse_8: To be observed and commemorated by every devotee turning (to Allah).
verse.verse_9: And We send down from the sky rain charted with blessing, and We produce therewith gardens and Grain for harvests;
verse.verse_10: And tall (and stately) palm-trees, with shoots of fruit-stalks, piled one over another;-
verse.verse_11: As sustenance for (Allah's) Servants;- and We give (new) life therewith to land that is dead: Thus will be the Resurrection.
verse.verse_12: Before them was denied (the Hereafter) by the People of Noah, the Companions of the Rass, the Thamud,
verse.verse_13: The 'Ad, Pharaoh, the brethren of Lut,
verse.verse_14: The Companions of the Wood, and the People of Tubba'; each one (of them) rejected the messengers, and My warning was duly fulfilled (in them).
verse.verse_15: Were We then weary with the first Creation, that they should be in confused doubt about a new Creation?
verse.verse_16: It was We Who created man, and We know what dark suggestions his soul makes to him: for We are nearer to him than (his) jugular vein.
verse.verse_17: Behold, two (guardian angels) appointed to learn (his doings) learn (and noted them), one sitting on the right and one on the left.
verse.verse_18: Not a word does he utter but there is a sentinel by him, ready (to note it).
verse.verse_19: And the stupor of death will bring Truth (before his eyes): "This was the thing which thou wast trying to escape!"
verse.verse_20: And the Trumpet shall be blown: that will be the Day whereof Warning (had been given).
verse.verse_21: And there will come forth every soul: with each will be an (angel) to drive, and an (angel) to bear witness.
verse.verse_22: (It will be said:) "Thou wast heedless of this; now have We removed thy veil, and sharp is thy sight this Day!"
verse.verse_23: And his Companion will say: "Here is (his Record) ready with me!"
verse.verse_24: (The sentence will be:) "Throw, throw into Hell every contumacious Rejecter (of Allah)!-
verse.verse_25: "Who forbade what was good, transgressed all bounds, cast doubts and suspicions;
verse.verse_26: "Who set up another god beside Allah: Throw him into a severe penalty."
verse.verse_27: His Companion will say: "Our Lord! I did not make him transgress, but he was (himself) far astray."
verse.verse_28: He will say: "Dispute not with each other in My Presence: I had already in advance sent you Warning.
verse.verse_29: "The Word changes not before Me, and I do not the least injustice to My Servants."
verse.verse_30: One Day We will ask Hell, "Art thou filled to the full?" It will say, "Are there any more (to come)?"
verse.verse_31: And the Garden will be brought nigh to the Righteous,- no more a thing distant.
verse.verse_32: (A voice will say:) "This is what was promised for you,- for every one who turned (to Allah) in sincere repentance, who kept (His Law),
verse.verse_33: "Who feared (Allah) Most Gracious Unseen, and brought a heart turned in devotion (to Him):
verse.verse_34: "Enter ye therein in Peace and Security; this is a Day of Eternal Life!"
verse.verse_35: There will be for them therein all that they wish,- and more besides in Our Presence.
verse.verse_36: But how many generations before them did We destroy (for their sins),- stronger in power than they? Then did they wander through the land: was there any place of escape (for them)?
verse.verse_37: Verily in this is a Message for any that has a heart and understanding or who gives ear and earnestly witnesses (the truth).
verse.verse_38: We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in Six Days, nor did any sense of weariness touch Us.
verse.verse_39: Bear, then, with patience, all that they say, and celebrate the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.
verse.verse_40: And during part of the night, (also,) celebrate His praises, and (so likewise) after the postures of adoration.
verse.verse_41: And listen for the Day when the Caller will call out from a place quiet near,-
verse.verse_42: The Day when they will hear a (mighty) Blast in (very) truth: that will be the Day of Resurrection.
verse.verse_43: Verily it is We Who give Life and Death; and to Us is the Final Goal-
verse.verse_44: The Day when the Earth will be rent asunder, from (men) hurrying out: that will be a gathering together,- quite easy for Us.
verse.verse_45: We know best what they say; and thou art not one to overawe them by force. So admonish with the Qur'an such as fear My Warning!
